endorsements.name: Luciano Hanna
endorsements.label: CVE-2024-13431
endorsements.description: The Appointment Booking Calendar — Simply Schedule Appointments Booking Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting via the accent_color and background parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.6.8.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that execute if they can successfully trick a user into performing an action such as clicking on a link.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.1)

endorsements.label: CVE-2024-13820
endorsements.description: The Melhor Envio plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 2.15.11 via the 'run' function, which uses a hardcoded hash. endorsements.name: Luciano Hanna
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-1119
endorsements.description: The Appointment Booking Calendar — Simply Schedule Appointments Booking Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary shortcode execution in all versions up to, and including, 1.6.8.5. This is due to the software allowing users to execute an action that does not properly validate a value before running do_shortcode. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary shortcodes.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.3)

endorsements.name: Luciano Hanna
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-1437
endorsements.description: The Advanced iFrame plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the plugin's 'advanced_iframe' shortcode in all versions up to, and including, 2025.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping on user supplied attributes. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This was partially patched in version 2024.5, and later improved in version 2025.3.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.4)
